questions.explanation: Spirited Away won in 2003; Miyazaki won the category again in 2024 with The Boy and the Heron.

questions.text: In Beauty and the Beast (1991), which enchanted object is Lumière?
questions.explanation: Lumière, French for light, is a candelabra; Cogsworth is the clock and Mrs. Potts the teapot.

questions.text: What was the first feature film made entirely with computer animation?
questions.explanation: Pixar's Toy Story (1995) was the first fully computer-animated feature; Antz and A Bug's Life both came out in 1998.

questions.text: Which 1928 Disney short with synchronized sound made Mickey Mouse a star?
questions.explanation: Steamboat Willie was a hit thanks to its synchronized sound; Mickey had appeared earlier that year in a silent test of Plane Crazy.

questions.text: In Despicable Me, what is the name of the supervillain who adopts three girls?
questions.explanation: Gru adopts Margo, Edith and Agnes; his rival Vector is the villain who steals the Great Pyramid of Giza.

questions.text: Which studio created the stop-motion duo Wallace & Gromit?
questions.explanation: Bristol-based Aardman makes clay stop-motion films such as Chicken Run; Laika is the US studio behind Coraline.

questions.text: In Zootopia, what kind of animal is police officer Judy Hopps?
questions.explanation: Judy is the city's first rabbit police officer; her partner Nick Wilde is a con-artist fox.

questions.text: Which was the first animated film nominated for the Oscar for Best Picture?
questions.explanation: Beauty and the Beast (1991) earned a Best Picture nomination a decade before the Best Animated Feature category was created.

questions.text: Who directed The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993)?
questions.explanation: Henry Selick directed it; Tim Burton created the story and produced it, which is why the film is often credited to him.

questions.text: In How to Train Your Dragon, what is the name of Hiccup's dragon?
questions.explanation: Toothless is a rare Night Fury; Stormfly is Astrid's Deadly Nadder and Hookfang belongs to Snotlout.

questions.text: What is Batman's civilian identity?
questions.explanation: Bruce Wayne is Batman's civilian identity. Clark Kent is associated with Superman.

questions.text: Which city does Batman primarily protect?
questions.explanation: Gotham is Batman's main city. Metropolis is most closely associated with Superman.

questions.text: What is Superman's Kryptonian birth name?
questions.explanation: Kal-El is Superman's Kryptonian name. Jor-El is his father.

questions.text: Which planet is Superman originally from?
questions.explanation: Krypton is Superman's home planet; Asgard belongs to a different superhero setting.

questions.text: What is Superman's best-known civilian name?
questions.explanation: Clark Kent is Superman's civilian identity, distinct from his Kryptonian name Kal-El.

questions.text: Which DC hero is Princess Diana of Themyscira?
questions.explanation: Diana of Themyscira is Wonder Woman. Supergirl is a different DC hero.

questions.text: Which DC hero is closely associated with super-speed and the Speed Force?
questions.explanation: The Flash is associated with the Speed Force, which is central to the character's super-speed.

questions.text: Which DC hero is commonly known as the King of Atlantis?
questions.explanation: Aquaman is associated with Atlantis and its throne, unlike the other heroes listed.

questions.text: What device does a Green Lantern use to channel willpower into glowing energy constructs?
questions.explanation: The power ring is a tool, not the source: it turns the wearer's willpower into constructs and is recharged from a lantern-shaped power battery.

questions.text: What is the Joker's most recognizable recurring facial expression?
questions.explanation: The Joker is repeatedly depicted with a broad grin, reflecting his clown-themed persona.

questions.text: Who builds and wears the Iron Man armor in the original MCU films?
questions.explanation: Tony Stark develops and wears the original Iron Man armor in the MCU.

questions.text: Which scientist transforms into the Hulk?
questions.explanation: Bruce Banner is the scientist who transforms into the Hulk; Peter Parker is Spider-Man.

questions.text: What is the name of Thor's famous hammer?
questions.explanation: Mjolnir is Thor's hammer in Norse myth and Marvel comics. Stormbreaker is the axe he forges in the Marvel films.

questions.text: Which fictional nation is the home of Black Panther?
questions.explanation: Wakanda is Black Panther's home nation. It is fictional, not a real African country.

questions.text: What rare metal is strongly associated with Wakanda?
questions.explanation: Vibranium is the rare metal associated with Wakanda. Kryptonite belongs to Superman stories.

questions.text: Which Marvel hero is the surgeon Stephen Strange?
questions.explanation: Stephen Strange becomes Doctor Strange after a career as a surgeon.

questions.text: Which superhero identity is shared by Peter Parker and Miles Morales?
questions.explanation: Both Peter Parker and Miles Morales use the Spider-Man identity; it is not limited to one character.

questions.text: What is the name of the talking raccoon in the Guardians of the Galaxy?
questions.explanation: Rocket is the raccoon-like Guardian. Groot is his tree-like companion.

questions.text: Which Guardian of the Galaxy resembles a living tree?
questions.explanation: Groot is the tree-like Guardian; Rocket is the raccoon-like member of the team.

questions.text: In Avengers: Infinity War, how many Infinity Stones does Thanos seek?
questions.explanation: The six Infinity Stones are Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time and Soul.

questions.text: What is Captain America's signature piece of equipment?
questions.explanation: Steve Rogers fights with a round, star-emblazoned shield he can throw and ricochet; the bow belongs to Hawkeye.

questions.text: In which real city does Spider-Man usually fight crime?
questions.explanation: Peter Parker grew up in Queens, New York; Marvel often uses real cities, while DC invents places like Gotham.

questions.text: Which metal is bonded to Wolverine's skeleton and claws?
questions.explanation: Wolverine's bones were coated with near-indestructible adamantium; vibranium is Wakanda's metal and Uru forged Thor's hammer.

questions.text: Which team of mutants was founded by Professor Charles Xavier?
questions.explanation: Xavier, a powerful telepath, founded the X-Men and a school for young mutants; the Justice League belongs to DC.

questions.text: What is the name of Bruce Wayne's loyal butler?
questions.explanation: Alfred raised Bruce after his parents' murder; Edwin Jarvis is the Avengers' butler, and Lucius Fox runs Wayne Enterprises' tech.

questions.text: Who is the Green Goblin, Spider-Man's foe?
questions.explanation: Industrialist Norman Osborn becomes the Green Goblin; Otto Octavius is Doctor Octopus and Adrian Toomes is the Vulture.

questions.text: Who is Thor's adopted brother in Marvel stories?
questions.explanation: Loki is a Frost Giant by birth, adopted by Odin; Odin is Thor's father and Heimdall guards the Bifrost bridge.

questions.text: What does Wonder Woman's golden lasso do to anyone it binds?
answers: Forces them to tell the truth
questions.explanation: The Lasso of Truth compels honesty; her creator, William Moulton Marston, also worked on an early lie-detector test.

questions.text: Which reporter is Superman's colleague and love interest at the Daily Planet?
questions.explanation: Lois Lane works alongside Clark Kent at the Daily Planet; Mary Jane Watson is Spider-Man's love interest.

questions.text: Which Avenger is the master archer Clint Barton?
questions.explanation: Clint Barton is Marvel's Hawkeye; Green Arrow, Oliver Queen, is DC's best-known archer.

questions.text: Which Marvel hero can shrink to tiny size and communicate with ants?
questions.explanation: Ant-Man's helmet lets him command ants; DC's The Atom can also shrink but has no insect powers.

questions.text: Which Batman villain is former district attorney Harvey Dent?
questions.explanation: Harvey Dent becomes Two-Face after half his face is scarred, and he makes choices by flipping a coin.

questions.text: Which writer co-created Spider-Man with artist Steve Ditko?
questions.explanation: Stan Lee and Steve Ditko introduced Spider-Man in Amazing Fantasy #15 (1962); Lee co-created the Hulk with Jack Kirby.

questions.text: In which comic book did Superman first appear in 1938?
questions.explanation: Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster's Superman debuted in Action Comics #1; Detective Comics #27 introduced Batman in 1939.

questions.text: Which Fantastic Four member can stretch his body like rubber?
questions.explanation: Reed Richards became Mister Fantastic after the team was exposed to cosmic rays during a space flight.

questions.text: What is the real name of the Avenger known as Black Widow?
questions.explanation: Natasha Romanoff is a former Russian spy; Wanda Maximoff is the Scarlet Witch and Carol Danvers is Captain Marvel.

questions.text: Which blind Marvel hero is the lawyer Matt Murdock?
questions.explanation: Matt Murdock lost his sight to radioactive chemicals that heightened his other senses, letting him fight as Daredevil.

questions.text: Which Marvel villain rules the fictional nation of Latveria?
questions.explanation: Victor Von Doom is Latveria's monarch and the Fantastic Four's archenemy; Magneto is the X-Men's chief foe.

questions.text: Which 2008 film launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.explanation: Iron Man opened in May 2008; The Incredible Hulk followed weeks later, and Thor and Captain America arrived in 2011.

questions.text: Which writer co-created Batman with Bob Kane but went uncredited for decades?
questions.explanation: Bill Finger shaped Batman's costume, origin and Gotham City; DC finally gave him official co-creator credit in 2015.

questions.text: Which artist released the album 1989 in 2014?
questions.explanation: 1989 is Taylor Swift's 2014 album. The number is its title, not its release year.

questions.text: Which artist released the album Thriller in 1982?
questions.explanation: Thriller is Michael Jackson's 1982 album; Prince is associated with Purple Rain.

questions.text: Which band released Bohemian Rhapsody?
questions.explanation: Bohemian Rhapsody is a Queen recording, not a Beatles or ABBA song.

questions.text: Who was Queen's lead singer on Bohemian Rhapsody?
questions.explanation: Freddie Mercury is Queen's lead vocalist on Bohemian Rhapsody. The other choices are separate artists.

questions.text: Which singer released the album 21 in 2011?
questions.explanation: 21 is Adele's second studio album, released in 2011. Its title is not the release year.

questions.text: Which artist released the 2016 album Lemonade?
questions.explanation: Lemonade is Beyonce's 2016 album, separate from Solange's own discography.

questions.text: Which group did Beyonce belong to before her solo career?
questions.explanation: Beyonce was a member of Destiny's Child before establishing her solo career.

questions.text: Which artist is associated with the album and film Purple Rain?
questions.explanation: Purple Rain names both a Prince album and the associated film.

questions.text: Which band released the album Abbey Road?
questions.explanation: Abbey Road is a Beatles album, named after the road associated with their recording studio.

questions.text: Which country is the pop group ABBA from?
questions.explanation: ABBA formed in Sweden, not one of the neighboring Scandinavian countries listed.

questions.text: Which country is the group BTS from?
questions.explanation: BTS is a South Korean group; K-pop refers to Korean popular music.

questions.text: Which K-pop group released the song Dynamite in 2020?
questions.explanation: Dynamite is BTS's 2020 single. EXO, SHINee and BigBang are different groups.

questions.text: Which group includes members Jisoo, Jennie, Rose and Lisa?
questions.explanation: Jisoo, Jennie, Rose and Lisa are BLACKPINK's four members.

questions.text: Which artist released the 2017 hit Shape of You?
questions.explanation: Shape of You is an Ed Sheeran single released in 2017.

questions.text: Which singer released Bad Guy in 2019?
questions.explanation: Bad Guy is Billie Eilish's 2019 song, not an Olivia Rodrigo recording.

questions.text: Which singer released the debut album Sour in 2021?
questions.explanation: Sour is Olivia Rodrigo's debut album, released in 2021.

questions.text: Which singer released the album Future Nostalgia in 2020?
questions.explanation: Future Nostalgia is Dua Lipa's 2020 album; it is not a Lady Gaga release.

questions.text: Which singer was a member of One Direction before releasing Sign of the Times?
questions.explanation: Harry Styles released Sign of the Times after his work with One Direction.

questions.text: Which artist released the album Born This Way in 2011?
questions.explanation: Born This Way is Lady Gaga's 2011 album and also the title of one of its songs.

questions.text: Which artist released the album After Hours in 2020?
questions.explanation: After Hours is The Weeknd's 2020 album, not a Drake or Bruno Mars album.

questions.text: Which singer is widely known as the Queen of Pop?
questions.explanation: Madonna earned the title through decades of reinvention; Aretha Franklin is the Queen of Soul and Tina Turner the Queen of Rock 'n' Roll.

questions.text: Who is known as the King of Rock and Roll?
questions.explanation: Elvis Presley earned the title in the 1950s with hits like Hound Dog; Chuck Berry and Little Richard were fellow rock pioneers.

questions.text: Which country is the singer Shakira from?
questions.explanation: Shakira was born in Barranquilla, Colombia, and mixes Latin pop with influences from her Lebanese heritage.

questions.text: Which country is Justin Bieber from?
questions.explanation: Bieber grew up in Stratford, Ontario, in Canada, and was discovered through his YouTube videos as a young teenager.

questions.text: Which British girl group's members were nicknamed Scary, Sporty, Baby, Ginger and Posh?
questions.explanation: The five Spice Girls each had a nickname given by the press; Posh Spice is Victoria Beckham.

questions.text: Which singer is featured on Mark Ronson's 2014 hit Uptown Funk?
questions.explanation: Uptown Funk is credited to producer Mark Ronson featuring Bruno Mars, whose vocals lead the song.

questions.text: Which singer released the 1998 debut single ...Baby One More Time?
questions.explanation: Britney Spears was 16 when the single was released; like Christina Aguilera, she began on TV's The Mickey Mouse Club.

questions.text: Which Puerto Rican singer recorded the 2017 hit Despacito with Daddy Yankee?
questions.explanation: Despacito is Luis Fonsi's song featuring Daddy Yankee; a remix with Justin Bieber later made it an even bigger hit.

questions.text: Which South Korean artist released the 2012 viral hit Gangnam Style?
questions.explanation: PSY's Gangnam Style pokes fun at the wealthy Gangnam district of Seoul; its video was the first on YouTube to reach a billion views.

questions.text: Which singer released the Christmas song All I Want for Christmas Is You in 1994?
questions.explanation: Mariah Carey co-wrote the song for her album Merry Christmas, and it returns to the charts nearly every holiday season.

questions.text: Which Caribbean island nation is Rihanna from?
questions.explanation: Rihanna was born Robyn Fenty in Saint Michael, Barbados, and was later named one of the country's national heroes.

questions.text: Which boy band was Justin Timberlake a member of before going solo?
questions.explanation: Timberlake sang with NSYNC from the mid-1990s; Backstreet Boys were their chief rivals, and both came from Orlando, Florida.

questions.text: Robbie Williams first found fame as a member of which British boy band?
questions.explanation: Robbie Williams left Take That in 1995 to go solo; Westlife and Boyzone are Irish boy bands.

questions.text: Celine Dion's My Heart Will Go On is the theme song of which film?
questions.explanation: The song is the love theme from James Cameron's Titanic (1997) and won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.text: Who wrote and first recorded I Will Always Love You, later a huge hit for Whitney Houston?
questions.explanation: Country star Dolly Parton wrote and released the song in 1974; Whitney Houston's 1992 version came from the film The Bodyguard.

questions.text: Who was the lead singer and bassist of the band The Police?
questions.explanation: Sting fronted The Police while playing bass; Bono leads U2 and Mark Knopfler led Dire Straits.

questions.text: Phil Collins was the drummer and later the lead singer of which band?
questions.explanation: Collins joined Genesis as drummer in 1970 and took over vocals after Peter Gabriel left in 1975.

questions.text: Who has written the lyrics for most of Elton John's songs since the late 1960s?
questions.explanation: Elton John writes the music and Bernie Taupin the words; Tim Rice wrote lyrics only for specific projects such as The Lion King.

questions.text: Which 1984 charity single did Bob Geldof and Midge Ure organize as Band Aid?
questions.explanation: Band Aid raised money for famine relief in Ethiopia; We Are the World was the American response, recorded in 1985.

questions.text: Which Swedish songwriter-producer co-wrote the hits I Kissed a Girl and Blank Space?
questions.explanation: Max Martin, from Stockholm, has co-written many pop hits since the 1990s; Timbaland and Pharrell are American producers.
